summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of abstract model fields being equal across different models by modifying the `__eq__`, `__lt__`, and `__hash__` methods. The changes seem minimal and focused on resolving the reported issue.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new dependency on `self.model` in the `__eq__`, `__lt__`, and `__hash__` methods, which might not align with the existing coding style or conventions in the Django project.
